description: This Python script implements an image generation workflow using an agent-based architecture. It includes functions for prompt creation, image generation, CLI helpers, and orchestrates multi-model image creation, with external dependencies on agentfield, pydantic, and standard libraries.

classes.name: DetailedPrompt
classes.description: Pydantic model for detailed image prompt with description and style notes.

classes.name: ImageResult
classes.description: Pydantic model for image generation result, including prompt used, image URL, and optional revised prompt.

methods.name: _api_settings
methods.description: Determines API credentials based on environment variables.

methods.name: create_prompt
methods.description: Generates a detailed prompt for image generation based on a topic.

methods.name: generate_image
methods.description: Creates an image from a prompt using specified model and size.

methods.name: generate_artwork
methods.description: Orchestrates prompt creation and image generation for a given topic.

methods.name: _slug
methods.description: Converts a model name into a URL-friendly slug.

methods.name: _extension
methods.description: Determines the file extension from an image URL.

methods.name: _save_image
methods.description: Downloads or decodes an image from a URL or data URI to a specified path.

methods.name: run_models
methods.description: Loops through models to generate and save images for a topic.

methods.name: parse_args
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments for the script.

methods.name: resolve_models
methods.description: Resolves list of models from arguments or environment variables.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point; runs image generation or starts agent server.
